messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — service=heartbeat-monitor-us-west, key=heartbeat.usw1, severity=warning, triggered 3 times in 4m. https://pagerduty.local/INC12345
mira: Acked — I'm on it. Pinging infra and checking dashboards.
alex: Seeing a very short 502 spike from canary healthchecks around 12:34:20–12:34:40 UTC, no user-facing errors on prod traffic.
mira: Running quick check: `kubectl get pods -n gateway -l canary=true -o wide` shows 2 restarts on gateway-canary. Pulling logs now.
jon: I pushed a small config tweak to canary earlier, not the full rollout. Could be a timing issue.
mira: Logs snippet:
```
2026-03-17T12:34:21Z gateway-canary-5f8d9 gc: connection reset by peer
2026-03-17T12:34:22Z gateway-canary-5f8d9 healthcheck: 502 response
2026-03-17T12:34:23Z gateway-canary-5f8d9 proxy: upstream timeout
```
alex: I'm not seeing increased errors for customer traffic (no spike in 5xx in traces). Looks localized to canary pods.
jon: I'll rollback the canary config just in case. Running: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/gateway-canary -n gateway`
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert updated — status: acknowledged by mira
mira: Rollback completed. Monitoring metrics and healthchecks.
blake: Metrics trending back to baseline, canary healthchecks recovered, latency stable. No user impact detected :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert auto-resolved (cleared by monitoring)
mira: Marking as noise/auto-resolve for now. I'll file a short follow-up to tighten canary gating and add a cooldown before traffic increases. cc @oncall-sre
alex: +1 on cooldown. Also suggest bumping heartbeat window to 6m so brief probe flutters don't fire pages.
jon: I'll open the ticket with steps and link to logs, assign to eng-runtime.
mira: Handoff to night oncall @aoife — please watch for reoccurrence, I'll be off in 30m.
aoife: Acked. I'll monitor dashboards and mute any ghost pages if there's no customer impact.
mira: Thanks everyone :heart:
